sentence_stem: I don't like cold weather, so
correct_completion: I usually wear a warm coat in winter.
full_sentence: I don't like cold weather, so I usually wear a warm coat in winter.
acceptable_variants: I always choose a warm sweater.
I stay inside near the heater.

options.text: I love going to the beach in January.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the first part. It does not follow logically from disliking cold weather.

options.text: I usually wear a warm coat in winter.
I walk to school every day.
options.why_wrong: This is true information, but it does not show a result of disliking cold weather.

options.text: I bought an ice cream yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This action has no logical connection with the first part, so 'so' does not introduce it.

grammar_focus: Result clauses with 'so' in the present simple
explanation: 'So' introduces a result. The second part must show the logical consequence of not liking cold weather.
translation: No me gusta el clima frío, así que normalmente uso un abrigo cálido en invierno.
